npcs.name: Mara Vell
npcs.motive: Keep the station calm until the signal is explained.
npcs.detail: Carries a cracked brass signal lens as a worry stone.

npcs.name: Osric Vale
npcs.motive: Recover a missing ledger before the Wardens find it.
npcs.detail: Speaks softly so people lean in before he bargains.

npcs.name: Sella Morn
npcs.motive: Stop anyone from opening the old tide road unprepared.
npcs.detail: Knows which foghorn patterns mean storm, ship, or warning.
